headline: Веганізм: у російській Вікіпедії інтерес стабілізувався після спаду; у чеській Вікіпедії інтерес продовжує падати.

verdicts.label: ru
verdicts.line: ru: інтерес стабілізувався після спаду. Частка уваги з 2024-12: 8,9 → 8,2 на 1 млн переглядів, −5 % за рік.

verdicts.label: cs
verdicts.line: cs: інтерес продовжує падати. Частка уваги з 2025-05: 12,0 → 7,7 на 1 млн переглядів, −30 % за рік.

observations.trend:veganism/ru: Verdict for the analysis window (September 2024 – August 2026): the attention share of веганізм in the Russian Wikipedia has stabilised since the step of December 2024 (the level then became 26 % lower than it was before). Its trend line runs from 8.9 to 8.2 views per million (−5 % a year). This is the report's verdict: tell the same direction.
observations.vs_edition:veganism/ru: In September 2025 – August 2026 against September 2024 – August 2025: the article on веганізм −33 % views, the Russian Wikipedia as a whole −22 %. The article lost more than its Wikipedia: only part of the fall is Wikipedia losing readers. (Twelve months against twelve: whether this is a steady move or one past step, the trend observation says.)
observations.decision:verdict:veganism/ru: Interest in веганізм in the Russian Wikipedia holds steady against its Wikipedia: the interest is there, with no sign of growth. Its views fall with Wikipedia as a whole, not on their own.
observations.trend:veganism/cs: Verdict for the analysis window (September 2024 – August 2026): the attention share of веганізм in the Czech Wikipedia keeps declining since the step of May 2025 (the level then became 25 % lower than it was before). Its trend line runs from 12.0 to 7.7 views per million (−30 % a year). This is the report's verdict: tell the same direction.
observations.vs_edition:veganism/cs: In September 2025 – August 2026 against September 2024 – August 2025: the article on веганізм −41 % views, the Czech Wikipedia as a whole −13 %. The article lost more than its Wikipedia: only part of the fall is Wikipedia losing readers. (Twelve months against twelve: whether this is a steady move or one past step, the trend observation says.)
observations.decision:verdict:veganism/cs: Interest in веганізм in the Czech Wikipedia is shrinking against its Wikipedia: Wikipedia gives no growth signal to check.
observations.editions:veganism: In September 2025 – August 2026 the article on веганізм is opened about 5,500 times a month in the Russian Wikipedia against about 560 in the Czech Wikipedia: the Russian Wikipedia is the much larger audience (about 10 times as much). Relative to the size of each Wikipedia the gap almost disappears (9.4 against 8.5 views per million views of each Wikipedia: the attention share): the larger audience in the Russian Wikipedia comes from its larger Wikipedia. Against September 2024 – August 2025 both are read less: the Russian Wikipedia −33 %, the Czech Wikipedia −41 % views, at about the same pace. The window's verdict on the attention share: it holds steady in the Russian Wikipedia and declines in the Czech Wikipedia.
observations.decision:editions:veganism: The Russian Wikipedia is the larger audience for веганізм and its interest holds steady, while in the Czech Wikipedia it declines: the Russian Wikipedia is the stronger signal of the two.
